exact.原文明確指出：very deep networks（通常超過約 20 層）加深後: The paper states explicitly: for very deep networks (usually beyond about 20 layers), going deeper makes the training accuracy saturate first and then get worse; in theory, extra layers could learn the identity, but in practice a plain network often makes the training error go up.
exact.不直接學 H，改學殘差 F=H-x，主路與恆等捷徑相加得到 H=F+x；恆等捷徑: Instead of learning H directly, learn the residual F=H-x; adding the main path and the identity shortcut gives H=F+x; the identity shortcut also greatly improves how gradients flow back during backpropagation.
exact.ResNet 採用加法 x_l = F(x_{l-1}) + x_{l-1}；D: ResNet uses addition, x_l = F(x_{l-1}) + x_{l-1}; DenseNet instead concatenates all previous layers. The number of dense connections is l(l+1)/2; a transition layer consists of a 1×1 Conv + 2×2 avg pool.
exact.EfficientNet（2019）對深度、寬度、解析度做複合縮放（Compou: EfficientNet (2019) applies compound scaling to depth, width and resolution; ConvNeXt (2022) modernizes CNN design, showing that CNNs remain highly competitive in the era of attention models.

3a9a3fd3c713.zh: 加深網路竟然會導致訓練誤差不降反升（退化問題）！ResNet 提出 $\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{F}+x$ 恆等捷徑打破深度瓶頸，DenseNet 以 $\frac{l(l+1)}{2}$ 密集串接實現極致特徵重用。從經典卷積、偵測器、池化三大積木，到現代 EfficientNet 與 ConvNeXt，CNN 始終是深度學習的宏偉地基！
3a9a3fd3c713.en: Making a network deeper can actually make the training error go up instead of down (the degradation problem)! ResNet proposed the $\mathcal{H}=\mathcal{F}+x$ identity shortcut to break the depth bottleneck, and DenseNet achieved ultimate feature reuse with $\frac{l(l+1)}{2}$ dense concatenations. From the three classic building blocks of convolution, detector and pooling to the modern EfficientNet and ConvNeXt, the CNN has always been the grand foundation of deep learning!

ffcf46256b96.zh: 既然深層模型理論上能學成恆等對映，為何加深反而讓訓練誤差變差？
ffcf46256b96.en: If a deep model can in theory learn the identity mapping, why does going deeper make the training error worse?

cdec755650d8.zh:
直筒網路沒有參考基準點，難以透過多層非線性逼近恆等對映！
ResNet 旁路架設恆等捷徑（Shortcut $x$），主路專心學殘差 $\mathcal{F}=\mathcal{H}-x$。多出的層只需學成 0，梯度直接暢通無阻流回淺層！
cdec755650d8.en:
A plain network has no reference point, so it is hard for it to approximate the identity mapping through many nonlinear layers!
ResNet sets up an identity shortcut (shortcut $x$) as a bypass, and the main path concentrates on learning the residual $\mathcal{F}=\mathcal{H}-x$. The extra layers only need to learn 0, and the gradient flows straight back to the shallow layers unobstructed!

3e43acd24bab.zh: 01 / 退化與殘差架構 · Degradation & ResNet

609d1c45889b.zh: 退化問題的本質與殘差學習數學形式 The Degradation Problem & The Mathematics of Residual Learning

91c297461f41.zh: 2015 年何愷明等人指出：當直筒網路（Plain Network / VGG 式架構）深度超過約 20 層時，訓練準確率會先達到飽和，隨後不升反降（訓練誤差上升）。這並非過擬合（Overfitting，過擬合時訓練誤差應為零），而是退化問題（Degradation Problem）！
91c297461f41.en: In 2015 Kaiming He et al. pointed out that when the depth of a plain network (a VGG-style architecture) exceeds about 20 layers, the training accuracy first saturates and then drops instead of rising (the training error goes up). This is not overfitting (when overfitting, the training error should be zero); it is the degradation problem!

1129bf8f60dd.zh: ❌ 直筒網路的困境 Plain Network
1129bf8f60dd.en: ❌ The plight of the plain network

71fbb0849ba2.zh: 理論上，深層網路至少不該比淺層更差——只要多出來的層全部學成恆等對映（$\mathcal{H}(x)=x$），表現就能精確複製淺模型。但在實務上，多層疊加的非線性權重極難最佳化出恆等函式，導致深層訓練陷入停滯與梯度阻斷。
71fbb0849ba2.en: In theory, a deep network should be at least no worse than a shallow one—as long as all the extra layers learn the identity mapping ($\mathcal{H}(x)=x$), it can exactly replicate the shallow model's performance. In practice, however, it is extremely hard to optimize stacked nonlinear weights into an identity function, so deep training stalls and the gradient gets blocked.

eeb79242e438.zh: ✅ ResNet 的殘差哲學 Residual Learning

b1b3c786405d.zh: 不再讓層直接學習無參考點的目標對映 $\mathcal{H}(x)$，改讓主路學習相對於輸入的殘差函式： $$\mathcal{F}(x) := \mathcal{H}(x) - x \tag{9}$$ 因此原本的目標對映被重組為： $$\mathcal{H}(x) = \mathcal{F}(x) + x \tag{10}$$
b1b3c786405d.en: Instead of having the layers directly learn the target mapping $\mathcal{H}(x)$ with no reference point, the main path learns the residual function relative to the input: $$\mathcal{F}(x) := \mathcal{H}(x) - x \tag{9}$$ So the original target mapping is rewritten as: $$\mathcal{H}(x) = \mathcal{F}(x) + x \tag{10}$$

21961aa1dfb2.zh: 殘差塊（Residual Block，Fig. 18）： 主路計算 $\mathcal{F}(x)$，旁路透過 恆等捷徑（Shortcut Connection） 將 $x$ 原樣傳遞並直接逐元素相加（Element-wise Addition）。若某層不需要學新特徵，只需把權重壓向 0（$\mathcal{F}(x) \to 0$），輸出立刻還原為輸入 $x$！更重要的是，反向傳播時梯度可藉由捷徑中的 $+1$ 直通淺層，徹底攻克梯度消失。
21961aa1dfb2.en: Residual block (Fig. 18): the main path computes $\mathcal{F}(x)$, and the bypass passes $x$ through unchanged via an identity shortcut connection and adds it directly by element-wise addition. If a layer does not need to learn new features, it only has to push its weights toward 0 ($\mathcal{F}(x) \to 0$), and the output immediately reverts to the input $x$! More importantly, during backpropagation the gradient can pass straight to the shallow layers through the $+1$ in the shortcut, decisively overcoming vanishing gradients.

fa5bbfccc8cd.zh: ResNet 殘差加法（式 11）： $x_{\ell} = \mathcal{F}_{\ell}(x_{\ell-1}) + x_{\ell-1}$。特徵通道數不變，維持資訊的原位更新與梯度高速公路。
fa5bbfccc8cd.en: ResNet residual addition (Eq. 11): $x_{\ell} = \mathcal{F}_{\ell}(x_{\ell-1}) + x_{\ell-1}$. The number of feature channels stays the same, keeping in-place updates of information and a gradient highway.

6346cf6920d9.zh: DenseNet 密集串接（式 12）： $x_{\ell} = \mathcal{F}_{\ell}([x_0, x_1, \dots, x_{\ell-1}])$。將前面所有層的輸出在通道維度堆疊，連線數高達 $\frac{l(l+1)}{2}$，實現特徵極致重用。
6346cf6920d9.en: DenseNet dense concatenation (Eq. 12): $x_{\ell} = \mathcal{F}_{\ell}([x_0, x_1, \dots, x_{\ell-1}])$. The outputs of all preceding layers are stacked along the channel dimension, with as many as $\frac{l(l+1)}{2}$ connections, achieving ultimate feature reuse.

7658a04e49b6.zh: 過渡層 Transition Layer： DenseNet 透過 $1\times 1$ Conv + $2\times 2$ Average Pooling 在 Dense Block 之間壓縮肥厚的通道數與尺寸。
7658a04e49b6.en: Transition layer: DenseNet uses a $1\times 1$ Conv + $2\times 2$ Average Pooling between dense blocks to compress the bloated channel count and spatial size.

b3c743adb7cc.zh: 核心三大基石： 卷積層三階段（卷積 $\to$ 偵測器 $\to$ 池化）。稀疏連線與權重共享把全連線的 $\mathcal{O}(mn)$ 砍成 $\mathcal{O}(kn)$，帶來平移等變性與空間先驗。

f6695e15d6bd.en: The evolution of receptive fields and depth: from LeNet's $5\times 5$ and AlexNet's $11\times 11$ to VGG establishing that "two $3\times 3$ layers are equivalent to one $5\times 5$, with 28% fewer parameters", stacking small kernels became the modern geometric standard.

b766c4ce7a7c.zh: 拓撲突破與捷徑革命： Inception 引入 $1\times 1$ 瓶頸層實現多尺度；U-Net 對稱跳接解救醫學定位；ResNet 殘差加法攻克退化問題；DenseNet 密集串接重用特徵。
b766c4ce7a7c.en: Topological breakthroughs and the shortcut revolution: Inception introduced the $1\times 1$ bottleneck layer to achieve multi-scale processing; U-Net's symmetric skip connections rescued medical localization; ResNet's residual addition overcame the degradation problem; DenseNet's dense concatenation reuses features.

5342720081ae.zh: 時代地位屹立不搖： 即使在注意力模型與 Transformer 席捲的當下，EfficientNet 複合縮放與 ConvNeXt 證明 CNN 仍具非凡的高效性與邊緣落地優勢，是深度學習永遠的基石！
5342720081ae.en: A standing that will not be shaken: even now, as attention models and Transformers sweep the field, EfficientNet's compound scaling and ConvNeXt prove that CNNs still have remarkable efficiency and advantages for edge deployment; they are the everlasting cornerstone of deep learning!
